hero.title: Vaibaamo
hero.desc: Vaibaamo is a Vibe Coding event. In these events, we discuss AI in general, share AI coding knowledge, and learn together.

features.origin: Vaibaamo was born from a wordplay: Vibe + Aamo (like 'koodaamo' or 'hautomö').
features.definition: It is a place ('-aamo') where good vibes and AI coding meet. The goal is to create a relaxed environment for learning and networking.
features.eventsDesc: Find upcoming events easily in chronological order. No fuss, just essential info: where, when, and who is coming.
features.communityDesc: See who has signed up and join in. Vaibaamo makes participation easy and social.
features.mapDesc: Integrated map view helps you visualize where things are happening. Click your way directly there.
features.techDesc: Built with modern technology (React, Supabase, Vite) for a fast and responsive user experience. And maybe there's something else... (hint: π)

concept.credits: © 2025 Vaibaamo Project. Built with love and code.
